dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Good Nara got any <color=#00E1FFFF>normal Starshroom</color>? Give Aranara one? Oh yeah, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Viparyas</color> too, just one!

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Normal Starshroom will do, just one</color>. Oh yeah, and <color=#00E1FFFF>a Viparyas</color> too!

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Golden Nara likes Starshrooms too, right? Everybody loves good mushrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: I can go back to Vanarana now, thanks to Golden Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Agh, these cabbage fairies sure run fast!
